source.title: Prelude in G minor, Op. 23 No. 5

extraction.music:
ew PianoStaff << 
ew Staff = "md" << 	ime 4/4 \clef treble \key g \minor 
ew Voice \RHone 
ew Voice \RHtwo >> 
ew Staff = "mg" << \clef bass \key g \minor 
ew Voice \LHone 
ew Voice \LHtwo >> >>

bars.description: Play printed bars 1–86 once; returns are written out, with no inserted repeat.

endpoints.basis: The opening G octaves and ensuing march begin near 1.55 s in the pitch overlay; the original broad search incorrectly selected their later recurrence at 3.96 s. The final G3/G4 attack remains near 209.63 s, following the written high arpeggio and rest.

provenance: Source MIDI tracks were inspected against the named score staves; staff labels do not claim contrapuntal voice separation. EXT: IMSLP - Muzyka and Gutheil editions. MEAS: Correct work/movement catalogue number and original piano scoring. INFERENCE: The recording’s exact edition, repeat choices, cuts and ornaments remain unverified; do not use MIDI duration as evidence of equivalence.
Read content/listen/rachmaninoff-prelude-op23-5.mjs and cache/analysis/rachmaninoff-prelude-op23-5.txt. Editorial sections are coarse; they are not forced alignment anchors.

The published source MIDI has an unmatched note-off at track 1, tick 4392 and is not accepted by the strict parser. Compile the complete original RHone/RHtwo/LHone/LHtwo source expressions with LilyPond 2.24 instead of ignoring MIDI errors or synthesizing note durations. The printed source remains unchanged.
